versions.changelog: v1.2.1: Added Security Disclaimers section to address scanner false positives. Documents whitelist-only file access, explicit exclusions, and pure-Python implementation.

v1.2.0: Language-adaptive messages (sender's language, not hardcoded Arabic). Multi-language triggers (🇸🇦🇬🇧🇯🇵). One-step install via agent prompt. Always deliver direct file + temp link. ClawHub global-ready.
Initial release: peer-to-peer skill sharing with bilingual README, ZIP packaging, temporary links, and auto-installer. Full Arabic+English support.
